structure.structure_en: Living room, rectangular, deeper than wide, 3.6 m x 4.5 m; ceiling 2.7 m; floor: medium oak wood planks laid lengthwise toward the far wall, continuous single-level floor plane, no steps. Front-left floor-to-ceiling window/sliding door behind curtains 3.2 x 2.4 m, sill 0 m, 50% along the wall. Camera 1.5 m high, 4 m to the far wall, 24 mm lens, tilt -2 degrees, horizon 45% of frame height. The number of openings is exactly 1; do not add or remove any opening. Opening proportion: the opening is nearly wall-to-wall, leaving only narrow piers at each end. Fixed features that stay: skirting board: painted timber skirting along the base of the right wall, approx 80 mm high; wall-mounted air-conditioner: split-type indoor unit high on the right wall near the far corner; electrical distribution box: recessed metal panel high on the right wall; weak-current box: small recessed low-voltage panel lower on the right wall; installed ceiling fittings: flush round ceiling light and a recessed downlight near the curtain wall.
structure.structure_en_model: The room is a rectangular living space, deeper than wide, with a flat plain white ceiling at about 2.7 m and no beams. A long continuous white painted wall runs along the right side, carrying a high wall-mounted split air-conditioner, a recessed electrical distribution panel and a lower weak-current box, with painted timber skirting at its base. The shorter far wall is almost fully glazed by a floor-to-ceiling balcony door or window concealed behind full-height curtains on a ceiling track. The floor is a single continuous plane of medium oak planks laid lengthwise toward the far wall, with no level changes. The camera sits at 1.5 m in two-point perspective angled toward the front-left corner.
